checkpoints.description: Task 'shooter-cycle-65-profile-disabled' completed successfully.
[1/2] Combat-feel cycle: dip the existing viewmodel while reloading, with a mid-reload pair and reload-drill parity

impact_assessment.why: The reload bar and completion cue exist, but the first-person gun stays rigidly at hip during the whole reload, so the weapon feels static while the magazine fills.
impact_assessment.benefits: A DATA-driven sine dip lowers and pulls back the gun during reload and returns it at completion, using the existing nodes and no new draws.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: viewmodel presentation only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no sim, ammo, timing or input change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first dip/return tests, a mid-reload capture pair at 960x540, reload-drill hash parity and the full gates.

[1/2] Enemies cycle: reject warden escort positions that overlap the boss or an existing escort, re-record the fairness reference and prove with a centre-summon pair and drill

impact_assessment.why: Cover-safe summon placement still allowed escorts inside the warden (ring starts at 1.2 m vs boss 1.0 m + mite 0.5 m) and overlapping each other.
impact_assessment.benefits: Escorts now spawn with real clearance around the boss and each other, so they can path and attack instead of clipping.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: summon placement and fairness fixture; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: deterministic RNG order, count and max_alive retained.
impact_assessment.mitigation: 40-seed overlap test, seed-12 capture pair, summon_overlap drill with spawn telemetry, and a re-recorded winning reference replayed by the fairness test.

[1/2] Levels cycle: mark the launch run-up with one shared-trim runway strip from the pad to the platform edge, with an approach pair and platform-drill parity

impact_assessment.why: The launch pad marks the takeoff spot but the 2.5 m gap to the platform edge is unmarked, so the intended jump line is guesswork.
impact_assessment.benefits: A lit runway connects pad to edge, making the jump route readable without new colliders or sim state.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: decoration only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no sim, collider, camera or save change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first runway test, an approach capture pair at 960x540, platform-drill hash parity and the full gates.

[1/2] Levels cycle: seal the campaign on clear so wave 4 cannot spawn or attack during the victory banner, with a banner pair and campaign drill

impact_assessment.why: Campaign clear is recorded at wave-4 entry, but the sim had already built wave 4 and kept spawning enemies during the four-second banner; the player could be attacked in a won run.
impact_assessment.benefits: The victory beat is safe and the arena is empty; wave construction stops permanently after the campaign win.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: sim victory state + game clear hook; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: wave/campaign flow only, no level geometry.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first seal test, a three-second banner pair, campaign drill telemetry and the full suite including the fairness replay.

[1/2] Graphics cycle: render dropped ammo caches with a shared glowing cube pool, a staged cache pair and a cache-bearing played run

impact_assessment.why: The sim drops ammo caches for 8 seconds, but no scene node represents them, so the pickup is invisible and impossible to seek intentionally.
impact_assessment.benefits: A visible amber cache cube marks the drop, using a shared mesh/material pool and no sim or collider change.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: scene presentation only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no cache lifetime, pickup, reward RNG or save change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first visibility/pool tests, a staged drop pair at 960x540, a campaign/cache drill and the frame-budget test.

[1/2] Audio cycle: map the existing cache_drop event to a distinct chime and AMMO CACHE DROP caption, with a forced-drop pair and a kited cache run

impact_assessment.why: The sim emits cache_drop when a kill leaves an ammo cache, but only collection is mapped; the drop is silent even though the cache is now visible.
impact_assessment.benefits: A short distinct chime and caption announce the drop at the kill, making the new cache visual findable without changing lifetime or rewards.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: event/audio/caption only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no sim, cache, reward RNG or save change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first forced-drop tests, a captioned pair at 960x540, cache-clip counts in kite 3000 and a WAV/spectrogram probe.
